name: noetloom
description: Create and maintain project-specific agent workflows with persistent requirements, feedback reconciliation, resumable plans, and evidence-backed delivery.

interface.longDescription: Create or adopt a project in your chosen workspace, reconcile feedback into its requirements and plan, resume from local records, and verify completed work. Noetloom supplies instructions, templates, and small Python helpers; your coding agent supplies implementation and execution. Requires a host with workspace file access and Python 3.11 or later. It does not listen to other conversations, run in the background, or grant deployment permissions.
defaultPrompt: Create a local project for an offline reading list and start implementing it.
Reconcile this project's latest feedback and continue its authorized work.
Check this project's acceptance evidence and explain what remains before completion.
